title: Platform Commons

Together, we strive to turn these platforms into public assets, creating a better world for future generations.

title: Radics
short_description: An applied learning sciences lab that develops evidence-based learning solutions focused on both cognitive and non-cognitive learning challenges, and runs R&D initiatives with education nonprofits to build empirical evidence and strengthen edtech capacity.
long_description:
Radics is an applied learning sciences lab that works with ed NGOs, govt departments and affordable private school chains to develop learning solutions rooted in empirical evidence. Their mission is to solve for multidimensional learning challenges faced by majority of learners that are superficially served by the current edtech ecosystem. They focus on both cognitive and non-cognitive factors that affect learning, and apply a range of learning engineering approaches to develop solutions that cause effective learning.

They also run an 18 month R&D engagement in collaboration with Dr Ramkumar Rajendran (IIT-Mumbai) - called the Learning Dynamics Lab, where they work with a select cohort of ed NGOs that aspire to generate empirical evidence for their interventions, while also improving their edtech capacity. The work of this lab has recenrly been featured on peer-reviewed forums such as T4E conference (IIT-Gandhinagar) and CELDA conference (croatia).

In past, they've collaborated with renowned institutions such as HGSE, Jacobs Foundation, Teach For India, Global School Leaders and Learning Links Foundation, and have run edtech efficacy studies across India and Kenya. Their solutions have featured in top 1% on global edtech funding platforms such as the Learning Agency (funded by Schimdt Futures, BMGF and Walton Foundation).

title: Stotio
short_description: Stotio helps businesses grow faster by using AI and storytelling to create clear, compelling narratives.
long_description:
"Stotio is on a mission to spread the magic of storytelling in business and in life. Their goal is to democratize growth narratives for businesses globally by blending the art and science of storytelling, data and behavioural science. In the AI world with transformation cycles getting shorter, businesses need to power growth outcomes linking strategy, sales, marketing and investment decisions. Storytelling led strategy makes the journey shorter, simpler and faster.
Their growth co-pilot empowers small businesses to quickly craft compelling narratives through intelligent prompts. Be it investment deck or sales-ready documents, brand positioning or thought leadership, with their original frameworks and AI enabled solution, small businesses can generate authentic narratives to raise money, build lasting brands, sell better and to champion thought leadership.
They also blend expert consulting and tailored training to maximize outcomes."

title: Tech4Good Community
short_description: Works to strengthen the technology capabilities of grassroots nonprofits and social enterprises by assessing tech maturity, building awareness, developing internal capacity and implementing sustainable open-source systems.
long_description: Tech4Good Community (T4GC) works towards strengthening the tech capabilities of locally rooted nonprofit organisations (NPOs) and social enterprises solving for development challenges across climate, disability, health, education and livelihoods with cross cutting areas of gender and communities. title: Tekdi technologies private limited
short_description: IT solutions provider focusing on enterprise-class digital solutions for societal transformation.
long_description:
Tekdi Technologies is a purpose-driven technology company building scalable, inclusive, and future-ready digital solutions that drive societal transformation. Since 2006, the organization has partnered with governments, nonprofits, social enterprises, and businesses across sectors such as education, governance, auctions, transportation, and more to unlock the power of technology for good.
The company specializes in designing and delivering secure, open-source, and high-impact platforms rooted in Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), Digital Public Goods (DPG), and Generative AI (GenAI). With a product-first approach and a legacy of engineering excellence, Tekdi bridges complex challenges with agile, sustainable solutions that scale.
Tekdi has been at the forefront of building foundational DPI and reusable DPGs that enable services at scale. Its platforms empower inclusion, ensure cost-efficiency, and foster digital equity across diverse ecosystems. The company is also leveraging GenAI to solve real-world problems through intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and adaptive learning tools—enhancing outcomes across sectors while accelerating innovation.
